anyOf.description: Knowledge tree path in canonical text, as the Hub writes it (percent escapes kept verbatim); / is the root

title.description: Exact case-node text in this source projection; absent when unavailable. It does not enter the case content identity.

path_labels.description: Exact ancestor-node texts in this source projection, in root-to-case order.

node_selector.description: The parser's exact selector of this source node, including positional selectors for duplicate ids.

node_parser.description: The parser id and version that produced node_selector.

node_key.description: The product reader's deterministic case key within this document, including duplicate-id disambiguation.

command_tree_root.description: Digest of the command-tree source used by this projection; null when no tree was read.

stories.description: Exact author-declared story identities from this source's declared structural fields.

defects.description: Exact author-declared defect identities from this source's declared structural fields.

has_expected.description: The product reader's structural observation that at least one expected-result node is nonblank.

module.description: Module from the product's declared directory structure; null when the structure does not identify one.

resources.description: Unique accepted exact tag literals; undeclared fields have no accepted tags. The original parsed author field is retained in resource_declaration.raw_json and content identity.

path.description: Knowledge tree path in canonical text, as the Hub writes it (percent escapes kept verbatim); / is the root

signature.description: reference a claim rests on: src, tree or rec; a knowledge entry is cited by its tree address

declaration.description: reference a claim rests on: src, tree or rec; a knowledge entry is cited by its tree address

catalog_type.description: string: any word (minLength/maxLength); int: decimal integer (minimum/maximum); enum: one of values; ipv4, ipv6: address; mask: dotted IPv4 netmask; port: 0-65535 (minimum/maximum narrow it); keyword: the literal keyword; hostname: bounded ASCII DNS labels (single-label and trailing-dot names allowed, no URL/IP coercion); ip_or_hostname: IPv4, IPv6 or that hostname according to the bound catalog contract

type.title: declared-parameter-type@1
type.description: Exact type name and declaration from the original contract/tree. Optional catalog_type reuses the existing catalog vocabulary; no help-text inference. Missing types have a separate undeclared state, not a string fallback.

value.title: typed-address-value@1
value.description: A value at a declared address/mask/prefix position only. Mask contiguity, address membership, and agreement with the referenced type are boundary checks; the spelling never determines its purpose.

parsed.title: parsed-parameter-value@1
parsed.description: Parsed representation selected by the referenced declared type. The boundary checks the parse against original bytes and type, not just this shape.

declaration.description: reference a claim rests on: src, tree or rec; a knowledge entry is cited by its tree address

role.title: declared-parameter-role@1
role.description: Exact role name and its published closed-set declaration; Hub checks membership, without name heuristics.

items.title: typed-parameter@1
items.description: An explicit supplied parameter at its zero-based signature position, bound to exact type and optional role declarations; no inferred defaults. Undeclared parameters cannot be represented as verified typed values.

items.title: command-identity@1
items.description: Complete command identity: locked command-tree root and full path, exact overload/signature reference and typed parsed supplied parameters. Hub resolves each declaration and fully consumes the command grammar; structural validity alone does not prove it is a command. Identity equality uses the canonical typed parameter projection in identityRules.command; raw text and role evidence are annotations, not duplicate-key inputs.

span.title: source-span@1
span.description: Zero-based offset and positive length in the original source bytes; the end is exclusive. Hub checks the span against the retained source, not against normalized text.

identity.title: expected-quote-identity@1
identity.description: Immutable identity of an expected quotation: original source digest, parser@major, exact selector and raw byte span. No width, whitespace or synonym folding.

anyOf.title: quote-evidence@1
anyOf.description: Verbatim quote paired with its original-byte identity; presence and item ownership are checked at the Hub boundary.

quote.title: feeding-quote@1
quote.description: Feeding uses an exact src selector quotation, as the approved page specifies. Raw-byte QuoteEvidence remains accepted when the parser can prove byte ranges. Missing byte maps are not guessed; no whitespace folding or new content parser is used.

title: fed-case@1
description: Content identity hashes the canonical caseStatement projection (autoid, priority, resources, original steps and expectations). Source, root, commands, bindings and annotations do not enter identity; repeated bytes from multiple documents remain one object. Invalid resource values remain in raw_json and content identity; the tag field is undeclared with one advisory violation. No literal recovery or whole-document rejection.
